integrity: The threshold is proved analytically by exact shift factorization and Green-kernel sign analysis. A bundled computation checks only algebra and a robust witness; finite numerical sampling is not used as proof of the universal claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the infinite one-dimensional lattice and the classical five-point fourth-order centered second-derivative stencil. Boundary closures and finite periodic sizes are not classified.
title: One third is the sharp positivity-recovery threshold for backward Euler on the classical fourth-order heat stencil
